## Passages
RESULT [curation]: Tested on Waymo, COCO and nuScenes with Faster R-CNN and BEVFormer. It reaches near-original performance while pruning 20% of the data, and it reduces the degradation relative to random sampling by over 54% on Waymo.
US [curation]: This is the closest published analogue to 'DINOv2 filter, then check with the detector'. Pure embedding dedup is task-blind, so a proxy YOLO trained on the base set can decide per cluster how much of a harvested cluster is redundant. The same loss-difference signal also works as a cheap screen before an increment ('does this cluster carry loss the base model has not already absorbed?').
CORRECTION [curation]: The abstract says 'over 54% versus random sampling on Waymo'. The results section words it as 'for up to 40% pruning ... reduces performance loss by at least 54%' on Waymo.
